description: Running WinUI app: read the layout values an element actually resolves to and where they come from (live XAML inspection, not UI Automation).
prompt: Harborlight is up from my debug session. On SettingsPage, Save sits a few pixels lower than Cancel even though they share a StackPanel. What Margin, Padding and VerticalAlignment does Save really end up with on screen, and which file sets them?
